message-send.comment: Order matters: a complete unary send is matched first, so the general rule below never has to decide keyword-vs-unary via a lookahead. TextMate matches begin patterns one line at a time, so any lookahead spanning lines is unreliable.

unary-message-send.name: meta.message-send.smalltalk
unary-message-send.comment: Complete unary send on one line: ⟦receiver selector⟧. Fails on keyword sends because a ':' follows the selector instead of ⟧.

keyword-message-send.name: meta.message-send.smalltalk
keyword-message-send.comment: Everything else: ⟦receiver sel: arg sel2: arg2⟧, spanning any number of lines. No lookahead, so multiline sends highlight correctly.
